name: Franklin County's YMCA Gymnastics, Ninja and Adventure Camps
description_short: Indoor gymnastics, ninja and multi sport day camps at Franklin County's YMCA on Main Street in Greenfield, plus a shorter Lil' Flippers camp for preschoolers. Campers rotate through gymnastics stations and obstacle courses, play team games and swim, with a skills showcase each Friday.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. Gymnastics, Ninja and Adventure camps: ages 5 to 14 (must be entering first grade), indoors at the Main Street facility, 8:30 am to 3:30 pm with complimentary extended care 7:00 am to 6:00 pm. Weekly fee $305 non member ($260 member); Lil' Flippers Mini Camp (ends 2 pm, potty trained) $245 non member ($200 member). Free breakfast and lunch through the Greenfield Summer Eats Program except the weeks of June 22 and August 17. Address and phone from the page footer.

Researched by Claude from this page. 2026 brochure: Gymnastics, Ninja and Adventure camps ages 5 to 14, Minis 3.5 to 5; seven weekly themes June 22 to August 7, 2026 (Week 7 optional for Tumbling Tigers team); Friday skills showcase; swimming daily at 1 pm. Session price is the non member weekly fee.
